mapper.sql: ( SELECT B1.DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT B1 START WITH B1.DEPTNO IN ( SELECT HRD.DEPTID FROM HR_DEPARTMENT HRD WHERE HRD.MANAGER_EMP_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) CONNECT BY PRIOR B1.DEPTNO = B1.PARENT_DEPT_NO UNION SELECT ASI.DEPTNO FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO ASI WHERE ASI.PERSON_ID = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ACC

H.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND H.DEPTNO = ACC.DEPTNO AND H.EMPID NOT LIKE '111111%'
AND TRUNC(H.DATE_STARTED) <= TO_DATE(#{year, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '1231', 'YYYYMMDD') AND (H.DATE_LEFT IS NULL OR TRUNC(H.DATE_LEFT) >= TO_DATE(#{year, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '0101', 'YYYYMMDD'))
AND ( UPPER(H.EMPID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%' OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(H.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%' )
AND INSTR(',' || #{deptNos, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ',', ',' || H.DEPTNO || ',') > 0

H.EMPID AS EMPID, H.LOCAL_NAME AS LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, NVL(GET_AR_OT_TOTAIL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('0101'||#{year, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'DDMMYYYY'),'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, H.PERSON_ID, '31'), 0) AS M01_APPROVED, NVL(GET_AR_OT_TOTAIL(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE('0101'||#{year,
